description: Lightweight Armoury Crate alternative for Asus laptops with nearly the same functionality. Works with ROG Zephyrus, Flow, TUF, Strix, Scar, ProArt, Vivobook, Zenbook, Expertbook, ROG Ally, and more.

latest_release.name: GHelper v0.291
latest_release.body: ### 🎧 [Headset support](https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/discussions/5964) - [ROG Delta S](https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6250): RGB and AI noise cancellation - New audio-reactive Music lighting mode for ROG Delta S, Cetra RGB and Clavis ### ⌨️ [External Keyboards support](https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/discussions/5710) - Custom per-key RGB fix for ROG Strix Scope II 96 Wireless https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6233 - Custom lighting restored after sleep for ROG Strix Scope II X https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6249 - ROG logo button RGB control for ROG Strix Scope II X https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6212 ### 🎮 Overlay - Optional CPU / GPU clocks https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6260 (https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/pull/6268) ### 🚥 Aura - Keyboard backlight follows ambient light sensor https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/4575 (https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/pull/5802) (https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/pull/6221) (thanks @xaviergonz) - RGB support for ROG Strix Arion SSD enclosure https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/3025 (https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/pull/6196) - Keyboard RGB fixes for Zephyrus S17 2021 https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6220 ### 🖱️ Mouse Settings - ROG Harpe Mini Core support https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6225 https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6232 ### ⚙️ Other changes - Firmware fan floors shown on fan curve charts https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6270 (https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/pull/6274) - Fixed Fn+C and flicker-free dimming hotkeys on ProArt PX13 https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6231 - Re-apply Fn-Lock after lid open / wake (https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/pull/6234) (https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/pull/6221) - Hidden Fn+Numpad bindings on TUF A14 FA401 https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6253 - Hidden GPU settings on Zenbook S16 UX5606 https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6251 - Aura and OLED settings tweaks for ProArt H7407 - Fixed driver updates detection https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6259 https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6242 - Power limits and GPU settings tweaks for ProArt P16 H7607 (https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/pull/6218) - Nebula ELMB toggle for ROG Strix Scar 18 G835LWG https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/5822 - Fixed E-Reading mode asking for admin rights on Vivobook, Zenbook and ProArt - Energy Saver button now turns Energy Saver off directly https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6169 - Extra delay before reapplying settings on wake up https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6123 - Fixed hotkeys stopping after ASUS services are re-stopped on startup https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6166 ### 💻 UI Tweaks - Fans + Power window no longer hidden behind top taskbar https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6263 - Fixed settings window position with PowerToys Command Palette Dock https://github.com/seerge/g-helper/issues/6198 - Translation updates - Minor UI tweaks, cleanups and stability fixes >[!NOTE] >This is a big update that took a lot of personal time and effort to build! Please consider [supporting the app](https://g-helper.com/support) to help fund future development.
